description_en: Obtain the URL of a call recording file based on the call creation time and the unique call ID, and then retrieve the call recording file using the URL
description_zh: 根据呼叫创建时间、呼叫唯一ID获取通话录音文件URL，根据URL获取通话录音文件
name: GetCallSoundRecord

parameters.help_en:
Call creation time. Format: YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss.


You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2717996.html API and check the date parameter in the Response Header to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫创建时间。格式：YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss。


可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2717996.html接口，查看调用后的**Response Header中的date**参数获取
parameters.name: create_time

parameters.help_en:
Unique call ID.


You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2717996.html API and check the Data field in the response parameters to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫唯一ID。


可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2717996.html接口，查看返回参数的**Data**获取
parameters.name: call_id

Code.description_en: Request status code. A return value of OK indicates that the request succeeded
Code.description_zh: 请求状态码。返回OK代表请求成功

Data.description_en: URL of the call recording file

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API invocation succeeded. Valid values:
true: Succeeded.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
调用接口是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败
